{{Top|canon=System Cell}}
A '''system cell''' was one of the basic units of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. Millions of system cells were deployed by Imperial Intelligence, existing on virtually every habitable world in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and even those uninhabited worlds with strategic or tactical value. System cells were generally staffed by between four and twenty personnel, although the number could range for one individual to a hundred. Personnel was often recruited from the planet on which it was based, with off-world training a rarity.<ref name="IS: SE">[[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Imperial Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>

Systems cells were isolated from one another, with all communications coming directly from the command structure above them. Equipped with a [[RWStar A/P Transceiver]], each system cell was expected to obtain other necessary equipment itself.<ref name="IS: SE" />
